newsitem.title: USA: PP&L forms retail power supply group.
newsitem.headline: PP&L forms retail power supply group.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power and Light Co (PP&L) said Wednesday that beginning April 1, it will compete with other suppliers to sell electricity throughout the Mid-Atlantic region.

PP&L's newly formed Retail Energy Supply group will be responsible for marketing electricity to existing customers in Pennsylvania as well as potential new customers in surrounding states as the market opens up to more competition.

The group's primary goal will be to sell power in the Pennsylvania customer choice pilot programs, which are expected to begin this summer, William Hecht, chairman, president and CEO said in a statement.
The pilot programs, passed last year, will allow the customer to choose the company that generates its electricity.
In addition to this restructuring measure, PP&L said it is forming a Generating group that will ensure that the company operates its power plants in the most efficent manner.
Also effective April 1, the Generation group will include PP&L's Susquehanna nuclear plant, with total generating capacity of 2,184 megawatts, as well as its fossil-fuel and hydro facilities.
PP&L, a subsidiary of PP&L Resources, Inc, provides electricity service to 1.2 million customers in central and eastern Pennsylvania.
